result.summary: Found 2 issues: the selected category does not match the displayed content, and horizontal carousel content is awkwardly clipped at the right edge.

issues.description: The “Pizza” category is visibly selected, but prominent results include poké, burgers, and ramen, making the filtered state appear broken or stale.
issues.suggestion: Refresh the restaurant sections when a category is selected, or remove the active Pizza state if the page is still showing unfiltered content.

issues.description: The category and “Fastest near you” carousels show sharply cut-off items at the right screen edge, including truncated restaurant text, which looks visually unfinished.
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent trailing inset and intentional partial-card preview, or add a fade/scroll affordance so the clipping clearly communicates horizontal scrolling.
